statBlock.name: Githyanki Xenomancer
statBlock.description: A githyanki researcher who travels Wildspace to find unfamiliar creatures. Captured specimens may end up in its laboratory on the Astral Plane.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Staff and Telekinetic Bolt.
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage one-handed, or 6 (1d8 + 2) two-handed. Either way, add 14 (4d6) psychic damage.
Telekinetic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell from the list. Wisdom sets the spell save DC at 16, and the spells require no components.
At will. Druidcraft, Light, Mage Hand (the hand is invisible).
2/day each. Invisibility (self only), Pass without Trace (self only).
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Forcecage, Plane Shift, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Astral Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. Worn and carried equipment travels with the githyanki.

statBlock.name: Gray Scavver
statBlock.description: A six-foot scavver that hunts in packs. The smell of blood draws it in, though a wounded scavver usually breaks off the attack.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The gray scavver survives without air.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Roll with advantage if the target is a creature below its hit point maximum. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Hadozee Explorer
statBlock.description: A Wildspace explorer who often navigates for a spelljamming crew. An explorer can cross gaps by gliding and carries a musket for longer shots.

sections.Traits: Glide. For each foot it descends through the air, the hadozee can extend its membranes and glide up to 5 ft. horizontally. Heavy armor or the incapacitated condition prevents it from gliding.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Safe Descent. When a fall would deal damage to the hadozee, it can spread its membranes to reduce that damage to 0 if it is wearing light, medium, or no armor.

statBlock.name: Hadozee Shipmate
statBlock.description: A hadozee deckhand who can climb the rigging and glide back down.

sections.Traits: Glide. For each foot it descends through the air, the hadozee can extend its membranes and glide up to 5 ft. horizontally. Heavy armor or the incapacitated condition prevents it from gliding.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Safe Descent. When a fall would deal damage to the hadozee, it can spread its membranes to reduce that damage to 0 if it is wearing light, medium, or no armor.

statBlock.name: Hadozee Warrior
statBlock.description: A breastplate-clad mercenary armed with a shortsword and light crossbow. Some work in squads aboard pirate ships.

sections.Traits: Glide. For each foot it descends through the air, the hadozee can extend its membranes and glide up to 5 ft. horizontally. Heavy armor or the incapacitated condition prevents it from gliding.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions:
Safe Descent. When a fall would deal damage to the hadozee, it can spread its membranes to reduce that damage to 0 if it is wearing light, medium, or no armor.
Uncanny Dodge. When an attacker the hadozee can see hits it, halve the damage it takes from that attack.

statBlock.name: Jammer Leech
statBlock.description: A barnacle-like plant that clamps onto spelljamming hulls and feeds on their magic. Its reddish-purple body hides inside a shell that matches the hull.

sections.Traits:
Spelljammer Overload. If the leech drops to 0 HP while attached to a ship with a spelljamming helm, the creature attuned to that helm makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 10 (4d4) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. On a success it takes half damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Unusual Nature. The leech needs neither air nor sleep.
sections.Actions: Spiked Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Attach to Hull. Fasten to a ship's hull in the leech's space, dealing 2 (1d4) piercing damage to the ship regardless of its damage threshold. This damage cannot be repaired until the leech is scraped off. While attached, the leech has speed 0 and can detach as a bonus action. A creature within reach can spend an action and make a DC 18 Strength check to scrape it off. Failure leaves it in place. Scraping it off deals no damage to the leech or the ship.
sections.Reactions: Magical Discharge (1/day). When the leech takes damage, it can fire at a creature it can see within 30 ft. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) force damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Ecology: Spores settle on hulls, then puncture them after a few days and grow shells about 1 ft. across. A mated pair produces 1d6 spores per month.

statBlock.name: Kindori
statBlock.description: A whale-shaped celestial that feeds on starlight. Small eyes along its front edge signal to others at a distance and flash to drive off predators.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The kindori needs no food, drink, or air.
sections.Actions: Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Flashing Eyes (Recharge 6). Project bright light in a 120-ft. cone. Creatures in the cone make a DC 14 Wisdom save or become blinded for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
sections.Ecology: A kindori has its own air envelope and gravity plane. Scavvers can live on it and eat the parasites growing there. A dead kindori's skeleton can carry a spelljamming helm and become a ship. Lunar dragons and solar dragons prey on kindori.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 31. Bonus action name follows the official Spelljammer errata.
